built: A replay set in this repository, never shipped: a script Sal starts that runs orbit's six default lifecycle commands (explore, propose, apply, the system review, the walk, archive) as real billed Claude Code sessions, each in a small throwaway project prepared at the state just before that command, three times each by default, and grades every session only by what orbit itself printed or wrote during that session. A run that is stopped part-way still keeps its record and stops the session it was running. A second script compares two such runs, says whether a cut is no worse than the baseline, and warns when the two runs' sessions loaded different skills, noting the skills each side loaded that are not orbit's. The checks that cost nothing run in npm test. CI now also checks the generated skills with Claude Code's own validator, pinned to one version.
seams: Each billed run asks Sal to type the model and a total cost ceiling, and refuses to start without them; it never starts a session that could take the spend past that ceiling. The CI build now fails when Claude Code's validator reports an error or a warning in a generated skill.
deviations: Two of the stage's exit criteria wait on Sal's billed runs: each case shown failing on a deliberately broken body, and the baseline recorded with its cost. Against the proposal: the cheap first run's ceiling is $8, not $3, because the runner sets aside each case's whole budget (up to $4) before starting it; the free checks also show every grader passing on the state its command leaves, which the proposal did not ask for; and the explore case no longer checks that the exploration's file exists, because no orbit command reads that file once the session ends, so nothing orbit answers could vouch for it.
detail: replay/run.mjs (record written before the first session and after every run; SIGINT/SIGTERM kills the session's process group), replay/compare.mjs (warning on a difference between the two sides' skill sets, a note of each side's non-orbit skills), replay/lib/ (trace reader counting orbit only in command position; after_seed printed-path graders reading only records later than the seed), six cases under replay/cases/, test/replay/ (41 tests; ten mutations shown caught across apply and the system walks), scripts/validate-skills.mjs with the validate:skills npm script and a failing CI step on the Linux leg.
